NOTE: v1 is deliberately formula-free ("formulas": []) — the customer has not yet supplied formulas.
Formulas arrive as v2 of this same "name": Organization.activeFormulaSetId gets repointed at that
point, and every project already pinned to v1 keeps that pin (Project.formulaSetId is never rewritten
by updateProject()) — so existing projects' summaries are unaffected by the v1 -> v2 upgrade.
Profiles (u_profile / i_profile / l_profile, fields on GLASS) are deliberately unbilled this stage —
there is no PROFILE_STOP slot (D-35). Profile billing is deferred to Stage 25 along with materialList.
See development-cycles/stage-23.md D-34, D-35, D-38 and 'The real starter catalog'.
